messages.text:
I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed the dead miner over to me.

The NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1 is almost always one of two things, and the next answer tells me which.

When you plug it in, what exactly happens?

1. Nothing at all: no screen, no LED, no fan movement.
2. Fans spin and the screen lights up, but it shows an error or 0 chips / 0 GH.
3. It boots fine but drops out or stops hashing after a while.

If there is anything on the screen, a photo of it is the fastest way for me to read it.
its dead and I swapped the power supply with same results

Good, that rules out the most common cause, as long as the second supply is genuinely up to spec.

Two things I need:

1. What is the replacement supply rated at, the volts and amps printed on it, and is it a unit you know works on something else? The NerdQaxe++ needs a solid 5V at 5A or more through the barrel jack. A weaker brick (phone charger, 2A to 3A) will look exactly like a dead unit.
2. With it plugged in, is there absolutely nothing: no backlight flicker on the screen, no LED, no fan twitch at all, not even for a second?

If you can send a short video of the power-up attempt plus a clear photo of the serial number on the back, that covers everything I would otherwise ask you for one at a time.
it is an Identical PS to the one you supplied/

Understood, same model brick as the one that shipped with it.

One thing matters there: those stock 5V bricks are the weak link on the Nerd units, and a spare of the same model that has never been proven can be dead itself. So:

1. Is that second brick one you currently use on another working miner, so you know it delivers? If yes, say so and that settles it.
2. And with it connected, is there truly nothing: no screen backlight, no LED, no fan twitch at all?

If the answer is "yes it works on another unit" and "nothing at all", I have what I need, and a short video of the power-up plus a photo of the serial on the back lets me pass the full picture to the team.
Listen I have other miners that the PS works on. The miner is dead
Handing this to Sarah with my findings.
